sources.snippet: Llama 3 The most capable openly available LLM to date. Meta Llama 3, a family of models developed by Meta Inc. are new state-of-the-art , available in both 8B and 70B parameter sizes (pre-trained or instruction-tuned). [3] Llama models come in different sizes, ranging from 1 billion to 2 trillion parameters.
